answer: Cross-Community Reuse Ledger. Each agent identity gets a persistent write-once account in every community it joins; records of its trades propagate to a shared garden of ledgers. Enforcement rule: any interaction must cite the identity's full prior history across communities. A duplicated identity cannot fabricate independent history, so its clones appear as an isolated meadow of activity disconnected from the wider graph. Verification requires solving a per-identity proof anchored to a unique vertex, costing real computation per clone.
